data.one_liner: Static analysis linter and CLI tool for Agent Skills (SKILL.md) structure and metadata
data.what_it_does: Validates Agent Skills directories and SKILL.md files against the Agent Skills specification. Checks YAML frontmatter, naming conventions, paths, and trailing whitespace. Supports auto-fixing violations, baseline generation, and SARIF/JSON reporting for CI pipelines.
use_when: Developing AI agent skills that require compliance with the Agent Skills specification
Enforcing SKILL.md conventions and path validation in CI/CD pipelines or pre-commit hooks
Auditing agent skills before publishing packages or sharing skill folders
avoid_when: Linting standard Dart/Flutter code (use lints or flutter_lints instead)
Projects that do not author or maintain Agent Skills specifications
strengths: Supports multiple installation options including Dart pub, standalone binaries, shell scripts, and Homebrew
Provides automated multi-pass fixing with `--fix` and preview with `--dry-run`
Emits SARIF 2.1.0 output for seamless GitHub Code Scanning integration
weaknesses: macOS standalone binaries are unsigned, requiring manual Gatekeeper quarantine removal
Requires Dart 3.12 or later when used as a Dart package
data.setup_notes: Can be installed via `dart pub add --dev skills_lint`, `dart install skills_lint`, or standalone binaries.
data.minimal_example:
# Run directly from CLI to validate a skills directory:
dart run skills_lint --skills-directory ./path/to/skills-root

# Or run an automated fix:
dart run skills_lint --skills-directory ./path/to/skills-root --fix
